literal: Having examined, having examined, he who does not take - friendship, in the end, oneself dying sorrow will give.
translation: Forming a friendship without examining the person again and again will ultimately bring sorrow that leads to one's death.
modern: பலமுறை ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல் ஒருவனுடன் கொள்ளும் நட்பு, முடிவில் தான் சாகும் அளவிற்கான துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against rushing into friendships without thorough and repeated evaluation. The repetition in 'ஆய்ந்து ஆய்ந்து' (examining again and again) emphasizes the need for continuous scrutiny before accepting someone as a friend. If one fails to do this, the resulting friendship will ultimately bring grief severe enough to cause one's own death.
